question: Who among the following is credited with being the 'Pioneer of Rocket Technology' in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tipu Sultan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tipu Sultan was born in **1750, in Devanahalli, Karnataka**.
 
• His father was **Haider Ali** strong leader who ruled **Mysore state (1761 to 1782)**.
 
• He was fluent in **Arabic, Persian, Kanarese and Urdu**.
 
• He was also known as the **Tiger of Mysore**.
 
• He ruled Mysore from **1782 to 1799**.
 
• He is being credited with being the** 'Pioneer of Rocket Technology in India**.
 
• Four wars were fought by him with the British in the year **1767-69(Treaty of Madras), 1780-84(Treaty of Mangalore), 1790-92(Treaty of Seringapatam) and 1799( Subsidiary Alliance)**.
 
• In the** Battle of Seringapatam** Tipu Sultan died fighting the Britishers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Lord Cornwallis
 
 
 
• Governor General of Bengal from 1786 to 1793.
 
• He is also called as** Father of Civil service in India**.
 
• He introduced a system of **Permanent settlement**.
 
 
 
 

 Babar
 
 
 
• He was the **founder of the Mughal Empire** in India.
 
• He fought the **1st Battle of Panipat **in which he defeated **Ibrahim Lodi**.
 
 
 
 

 Akbar II
 
 
 
• He was Mughal Emperor who ruled India from 1806 to 1837.
 
• He gave the** title of Raja to Raja Rammohan Roy**.
